questions.stem: What is the formula for the perimeter of a square?
questions.solution: The perimeter of a square is calculated by multiplying the length of one side by 4. This is because a square has four equal sides. The other options are formulas for the area of a rectangle, the perimeter of a rectangle, and the sum of two sides, which are incorrect for a square.

questions.stem: If a rectangle has an area of 24 sq units and a length of 6 units, what is its width?
questions.solution: The area of a rectangle is calculated by multiplying its length and width. So, width = area ÷ length = 24 ÷ 6 = 4 units. The other options are incorrect because they do not correctly divide the area by the length.

hi.stem: यदि एक आयत के क्षेत्रफल 24 वर्ग इकाई है और इसकी लंबाई 6 इकाई है, तो इसकी चौड़ाई क्या है?
hi.solution: एक आयत का क्षेत्रफल इसकी लंबाई और चौड़ाई के गुणनफल द्वारा गणना की जाती है। इसलिए, चौड़ाई = क्षेत्रफल ÷ लंबाई = 24 ÷ 6 = 4 इकाई। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे क्षेत्रफल को लंबाई से सही तरीके से विभाजित नहीं करते।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology as found in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: What is the area of a rectangle with length 2 m and width 7 m?
questions.solution: The area of a rectangle is calculated by multiplying its length and width. So, 2 m × 7 m = 14 sq. m. The other options are incorrect because they either add the length and width instead of multiplying or use one of the dimensions as the area.

questions.stem: A rectangle has a length of 15 cm and a width of 8 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.solution: The perimeter of a rectangle is calculated as 2 × (length + width). So, 2 × (15 + 8) = 2 × 23 = 46 cm. The other options are incorrect calculations based on wrong formulas or miscalculations.

hi.stem: एक आयत की लंबाई 15 सेमी और चौड़ाई 8 सेमी है। इसका परिमाप क्या है?
hi.solution: एक आयत का परिमाप 2 × (लंबाई + चौड़ाई) के रूप में गणना की जाती है। इसलिए, 2 × (15 + 8) = 2 × 23 = 46 सेमी। अन्य विकल्प गलत सूत्रों या गणना त्रुटियों पर आधारित हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.solution: एका आयताचा वेगळा 2 × (लांबी + रुंदी) असा गणित करतात. म्हणून, 2 × (15 + 8) = 2 × 23 = 46 सेमी. इतर विकल्प चुकीच्या सूत्रांवर किंवा चुकीच्या गणितांवर आधारित आहेत.

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 5 cm?
questions.solution: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 3 × side length. For a side length of 5 cm, the perimeter is 3 × 5 = 15 cm. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the correct multiplication result.

hi.stem: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का परिमाप क्या है जिसकी भुजा की लंबाई 5 सेमी है?
hi.solution: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का परिमाप 3 × भुजा की लंबाई होता है। 5 सेमी भुजा की लंबाई के लिए, परिमाप 3 × 5 = 15 सेमी है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सही गुणन परिणाम के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।

questions.stem: A rectangle has an area of 180 sq ft. If its length is 15 ft, what is the breadth?
questions.solution: The area of a rectangle is length multiplied by breadth. So, breadth = area ÷ length = 180 ÷ 15 = 12 ft. The other options either use the length as the breadth or divide incorrectly.

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a regular polygon with 6 sides, if each side is 5 units long?
questions.solution: The perimeter of a regular polygon is the sum of all its sides. Since each side is 5 units and there are 6 sides, the perimeter is 6 × 5 = 30 units. The option '15 units' incorrectly adds only 3 sides. '20 units' and '40 units' are also incorrect calculations.

hi.stem: एक सम बहुभुज का परिमाप क्या है जिसकी 6 भुजाएं हैं और प्रत्येक भुजा 5 इकाई लंबी है?

questions.stem: A square is folded in half and then cut into two rectangles. Which of the following is always true?
choices: The area of each rectangle is half the area of the square.
The perimeter of each rectangle is half the perimeter of the square.
The area of the square is three times the area of each rectangle.
The perimeter of the square is greater than the perimeter of each rectangle.
questions.solution: When a square is folded in half and cut into two rectangles, each rectangle has half the area of the original square. The other options are not always true because the perimeter of the rectangles can be greater or less than the perimeter of the square depending on the direction of the fold.
